decisions.name: NanoCommons Knowledge Base
decisions.anonymous_access: NO: official manual describes partner-restricted authenticated access
decisions.api_or_export: REST API is documented, but the live KB/data access is not anonymous in the audited path
decisions.license_signal: CC-BY-4.0 for handbook only; dataset-level licenses vary
decisions.schema_relevance: high: material characterization, transformation, omics, toxicity, exposure and fate
decisions.next_step: Use only public linked source records or repository mirrors; do not request credentials.

decisions.name: eNanoMapper public database
decisions.anonymous_access: YES: public search/data page and anonymous API route are documented
decisions.api_or_export: REST API and JSON/XLSX/RDF-style export routes are documented
decisions.license_signal: Ontology CC-BY-3.0 is documented; per-record data licenses require verification
decisions.schema_relevance: high: nanomaterial characterization, biological and toxicological information
decisions.next_step: Capture public metadata and per-record license/provenance; admit data files only after record-level policy checks.

decisions.name: Nanomaterial-Biological Interactions Knowledgebase
decisions.anonymous_access: PUBLIC WEB LANDING PAGE OBSERVED; authenticated/API/export contract not verified
decisions.api_or_export: No stable official API or machine-readable export contract found in the audited public material
decisions.license_signal: No explicit redistribution license found on the audited landing page
decisions.schema_relevance: high: material properties, synthesis, and interactions across molecular/cellular/organismal levels
decisions.next_step: Retain landing-page pointer only; seek official export and license statement before adapter work.

decisions.name: nanoPharos
decisions.anonymous_access: PUBLIC DATASET ACCESS IS DOCUMENTED; endpoint behavior and access scope require fixture verification
decisions.api_or_export: REST API and CSV/XLSX/XML dataset access are described by project documentation and publications
decisions.license_signal: Dataset licenses are referenced as part of FAIR metadata but were not uniformly verified per dataset
decisions.schema_relevance: high: physicochemical properties, biointeractions, adverse effects, exposure and computational descriptors
decisions.next_step: Use DOI/Zenodo mirrors for redistributable files; capture nanoPharos metadata and dataset license before any direct asset admission.

decisions.name: PubChem and ChEMBL public substitutes
decisions.anonymous_access: YES: official public APIs were implemented and fixture-tested
decisions.api_or_export: JSON metadata and structure/property routes are available; no credential is used
decisions.license_signal: Source-specific public-use signals are already policy-gated in the repository
decisions.schema_relevance: medium: chemical identity and ligand/property fields, not full nano-bio experiments
decisions.next_step: Use as chemical identity/structure supplements; do not treat them as replacements for corona or protocol data.

decisions.name: Zenodo, Figshare and OSF public release mirrors
decisions.anonymous_access: YES for public metadata/releases; provider-specific visibility is checked per record
decisions.api_or_export: Official APIs expose DOI/release metadata and public file pointers
decisions.license_signal: Per-release license is captured and policy-gated before fetch
decisions.schema_relevance: medium-high: supplementary tables, datasets, code and provenance
decisions.next_step: Prefer release records with explicit license and SHA-256; retain metadata-only pointers when either is missing.
